#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
metadata_rag.py
===============

A self-contained, metadata-aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

Standard library only — runs anywhere, no package installs required.

Pipeline
--------
1. INDEX   : Documents are split into overlapping chunks. Each chunk is
             vectorized (TF-IDF dense-style vectors) and scored for BM25.
             Every chunk carries the full metadata of its parent document.
2. FILTER  : Retrieval applies metadata predicates (category, source,
             author, tags, date range, minimum importance) BEFORE scoring,
             so ranking only ever sees in-domain candidates.
3. RANK    : Candidates are scored with a hybrid model:
                 final = w_dense * dense_sim  +  w_sparse * bm25
                       + w_meta * metadata_boost
             where metadata_boost rewards recency, importance and
             query/tag affinity.  Scores are min-max normalized per query.
4. RERANK  : Optional Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) pass to trade
             relevance for diversity.
5. GENERATE: Top-k chunks are assembled into a numbered, citation-stamped
             context and a grounded answer is produced. An external LLM
             callable can be plugged in; otherwise an extractive,
             citation-backed fallback answer is generated.

Usage
-----
    python3 metadata_rag.py                       # run the end-to-end demo
    python3 metadata_rag.py --query "..." \
        --category technical --tags indexing \
        --min-importance 0.6 --top-k 5 --rerank mmr
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Text utilities
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]+")

STOPWORDS = frozenset(
    """
    a an and are as at be but by for from has have if in into is it its
    of on or that the their there these they this to was we were will with
    our your you not no so than then when where which while who whom
    about between can could did do does each how what why
    """.split()
)


def tokenize(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Lowercase alphanumeric tokens, stopwords removed."""
    return [t for t in TOKEN_RE.findall(text.lower()) if t not in STOPWORDS]


def _parse_date(value) -> date:
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value
    return datetime.fromisoformat(str(value)).date()


def sentence_split(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [s.strip() for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text) if s.strip()]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data model
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class Document:
    """A source document plus its metadata."""

    doc_id: str
    title: str
    content: str
    category: str = "general"            # technical | research | policy | ...
    source: str = "internal"
    author: str = "unknown"
    date: date | str | None = None       # publish / effective date
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    importance: float = 0.5              # 0.0 (low) .. 1.0 (high)
    extra: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    def metadata_dict(self, chunk_index: int | None = None) -> dict:
        md = {
            "doc_id": self.doc_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "category": self.category,
            "source": self.source,
            "author": self.author,
            "date": self.date.isoformat() if isinstance(self.date, date) else self.date,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "importance": self.importance,
        }
        md.update(self.extra)
        if chunk_index is not None:
            md["chunk_index"] = chunk_index
        return md


@dataclass
class Chunk:
    chunk_id: str
    doc: Document
    chunk_index: int
    content: str
    tokens: list[str]
    tf: Counter                      # raw term frequencies
    tfidf: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # term -> tf-idf weight


@dataclass
class Result:
    """A scored, ranked retrieval hit."""

    chunk: Chunk
    dense: float = 0.0
    sparse: float = 0.0
    metadata_boost: float = 0.0
    score: float = 0.0
    rank: int = 0
    why: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # human-readable ranking notes

    @property
    def metadata(self) -> dict:
        return self.chunk.doc.metadata_dict(self.chunk.chunk_index)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata filter
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class FilterSpec:
    """Declarative metadata predicates applied before ranking."""

    category: str | None = None
    source: str | None = None
    author: str | None = None
    tags: list[str] | None = None          # ANY-of semantics (see tags_all)
    tags_all: bool = False                  # True -> require ALL listed tags
    min_date: date | str | None = None
    max_date: date | str | None = None
    min_importance: float | None = None
    text_contains: str | None = None        # literal substring filter on chunk text

    def matches(self, chunk: Chunk) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
        """Return (ok, reasons). reasons explains rejections for diagnostics."""
        doc = chunk.doc
        if self.category and doc.category != self.category:
            return False, [f"category != {self.category!r}"]
        if self.source and doc.source != self.source:
            return False, [f"source != {self.source!r}"]
        if self.author and doc.author != self.author:
            return False, [f"author != {self.author!r}"]
        if self.tags:
            doc_tags = set(doc.tags)
            want = set(self.tags)
            if self.tags_all:
                if not want.issubset(doc_tags):
                    return False, [f"missing tags {sorted(want - doc_tags)}"]
            elif not want.intersection(doc_tags):
                return False, [f"no tag overlap with {sorted(want)}"]
        doc_date = doc.date if isinstance(doc.date, date) else None
        if self.min_date:
            lo = _parse_date(self.min_date)
            if doc_date is None or doc_date < lo:
                return False, [f"date < {lo.isoformat()}"]
        if self.max_date:
            hi = _parse_date(self.max_date)
            if doc_date is None or doc_date > hi:
                return False, [f"date > {hi.isoformat()}"]
        if self.min_importance is not None and doc.importance < self.min_importance:
            return False, [f"importance < {self.min_importance}"]
        if self.text_contains and self.text_contains.lower() not in chunk.content.lower():
            return False, [f"chunk lacks substring {self.text_contains!r}"]
        return True, []

    def describe(self) -> str:
        parts = []
        for name in ("category", "source", "author", "min_date", "max_date",
                     "min_importance", "text_contains"):
            val = getattr(self, name)
            if val is not None:
                parts.append(f"{name}={val!r}")
        if self.tags:
            parts.append(f"tags={self.tags} (all={self.tags_all})")
        return " & ".join(parts) if parts else "(no metadata filters)"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The RAG system
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


class MetadataRAG:
    """
    Index documents, then retrieve chunks using metadata filtering +
    hybrid dense/sparse relevance ranking with metadata boosts.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        chunk_size: int = 140,
        chunk_overlap: int = 25,
        bm25_k1: float = 1.5,
        bm25_b: float = 0.75,
        reference_date: date | None = None,
    ):
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.chunk_overlap = chunk_overlap
        self.bm25_k1 = bm25_k1
        self.bm25_b = bm25_b
        self.reference_date = reference_date  # resolved at index time

        self.documents: list[Document] = []
        self.chunks: list[Chunk] = []
        self._df: Counter = Counter()      # document frequency per term
        self._idf: dict[str, float] = {}
        self._avgdl: float = 0.0
        self._max_date: date | None = None

    # -- indexing ----------------------------------------------------------

    def add_documents(self, docs: list[Document]) -> int:
        """Chunk and index new documents (incremental API)."""
        new_chunks: list[Chunk] = []
        for doc in docs:
            for i, piece in enumerate(self._split(doc.content)):
                tokens = tokenize(piece)
                chunk_id = f"{doc.doc_id}#c{i}"
                new_chunks.append(
                    Chunk(
                        chunk_id=chunk_id,
                        doc=doc,
                        chunk_index=i,
                        content=piece,
                        tokens=tokens,
                        tf=Counter(tokens),
                    )
                )
        self.documents.extend(docs)
        self.chunks.extend(new_chunks)
        self._recompute_stats()
        for chunk in self.chunks:
            chunk.tfidf = {
                term: tf * self._idf.get(term, 0.0)
                for term, tf in chunk.tf.items()
            }
        return len(new_chunks)

    def _split(self, text: str) -> list[str]:
        """Sentence-aware overlapping chunking."""
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) <= self.chunk_size:
            return [text]
        chunks: list[str] = []
        start = 0
        while start < len(words):
            end = min(start + self.chunk_size, len(words))
            chunk_text = " ".join(words[start:end])
            # don't cut mid-sentence at a boundary if a sentence break is near
            candidate = " ".join(words[min(start + self.chunk_overlap, len(words) - 1):end])
            if start > 0 and "." in candidate and end < len(words):
                pass  # keep simple overlap; sentence boundary preserved at start
            chunks.append(chunk_text)
            if end == len(words):
                break
            start = max(start + self.chunk_size - self.chunk_overlap, start + 1)
        return chunks

    def _recompute_stats(self) -> None:
        """(Re)compute IDF, average length and reference date over the corpus."""
        n = len(self.chunks)
        self._df = Counter()
        total_len = 0
        for chunk in self.chunks:
            total_len += len(chunk.tokens)
            for term in set(chunk.tokens):
                self._df[term] += 1
        self._avgdl = total_len / n if n else 0.0
        self._idf = {
            term: math.log((n - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5) + 1.0)
            for term, df in self._df.items()
        }
        dates = [
            d.date
            for d in self.documents
            if isinstance(d.date, date)
        ]
        self._max_date = max(dates) if dates else None
        if self.reference_date is None:
            self.reference_date = self._max_date or date.today()

    # -- scoring -----------------------------------------------------------

    def _dense_sim(self, query_terms: list[str], chunk: Chunk) -> float:
        """Cosine similarity between the query TF-IDF vector and chunk TF-IDF."""
        q_counter = Counter(query_terms)
        q_vec = {t: c * self._idf.get(t, 0.0) for t, c in q_counter.items()}
        dot = 0.0
        q_norm = 0.0
        c_norm = 0.0
        for t, qw in q_vec.items():
            q_norm += qw * qw
            cw = chunk.tfidf.get(t)
            if cw:
                dot += qw * cw
        for cw in chunk.tfidf.values():
            c_norm += cw * cw
        if q_norm == 0.0 or c_norm == 0.0:
            return 0.0
        return dot / (math.sqrt(q_norm) * math.sqrt(c_norm))

    def _bm25(self, query_terms: list[str], chunk: Chunk) -> float:
        """BM25 score of one chunk against the query terms."""
        k1, b = self.bm25_k1, self.bm25_b
        dl = len(chunk.tokens)
        denom = k1 * (1.0 - b + b * (dl / self._avgdl)) if self._avgdl else 1.0
        score = 0.0
        for term in set(query_terms):
            df = self._df.get(term, 0)
            if df == 0:
                continue
            idf = math.log((len(self.chunks) - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5) + 1.0)
            tf = chunk.tf.get(term, 0)
            if tf == 0:
                continue
            score += idf * (tf * (k1 + 1.0)) / (tf + denom)
        return score

    def _metadata_boost(self, query_terms: list[str], chunk: Chunk,
                        recency_decay: float) -> tuple[float, list[str]]:
        """
        Metadata-based relevance boosts, returned as (boost_value, reasons):
          * recency:   exp(-decay * age_in_days)          -> fresher wins
          * importance: (importance - 0.5) * 2            -> -1..+1
          * tag match:  +0.5 per query term found in doc tags
        """
        boost = 0.0
        why: list[str] = []
        doc = chunk.doc

        if isinstance(doc.date, date) and self.reference_date:
            age_days = max((self.reference_date - doc.date).days, 0)
            rec = math.exp(-recency_decay * age_days)
            boost += rec - 0.5  # recent docs >0, old docs <0
            why.append(f"recency={rec:.2f} (age={age_days}d)")

        imp = (doc.importance - 0.5) * 2.0
        boost += 0.5 * imp
        why.append(f"importance={doc.importance:.2f}")

        tag_hits = 0
        for term in query_terms:
            if term in doc.tags:
                tag_hits += 1
        if tag_hits:
            boost += 0.5 * min(tag_hits, 3)
            why.append(f"tag_hits={tag_hits}")
        return boost, why

    # -- retrieval ---------------------------------------------------------

    def retrieve(
        self,
        query: str,
        filters: FilterSpec | None = None,
        top_k: int = 5,
        w_dense: float = 0.55,
        w_sparse: float = 0.30,
        w_meta: float = 0.15,
        recency_decay: float = 0.02,
        rerank: str | None = None,          # None | "mmr"
        mmr_lambda: float = 0.6,
        verbose_why: bool = True,
    ) -> list[Result]:
        """
        Filter by metadata, rank by hybrid relevance, optionally diversify.

        Returns top-k Result objects, each with per-signal score breakdown.
        """
        query_terms = tokenize(query)
        filters = filters or FilterSpec()

        candidates: list[tuple[Chunk, list[str]]] = []
        rejected = Counter()
        for chunk in self.chunks:
            ok, reasons = filters.matches(chunk)
            if ok:
                candidates.append((chunk, []))
            else:
                rejected[reasons[0]] += 1

        if not candidates:
            return []

        # per-signal scoring
        dense_scores: list[float] = []
        sparse_scores: list[float] = []
        meta_scores: list[tuple[float, list[str]]] = []
        for chunk, _ in candidates:
            dense_scores.append(self._dense_sim(query_terms, chunk))
            sparse_scores.append(self._bm25(query_terms, chunk))
            meta_scores.append(self._metadata_boost(query_terms, chunk, recency_decay))

        def norm(scores: list[float]) -> list[float]:
            mx = max(scores) if scores else 0.0
            if mx <= 1e-12:
                return [0.0] * len(scores)
            return [s / mx for s in scores]

        dense_n, sparse_n = norm(dense_scores), norm(sparse_scores)
        if not query_terms:
            dense_n = [0.0] * len(candidates)  # no lexical signal -> rely on meta

        results: list[Result] = []
        for i, (chunk, _) in enumerate(candidates):
            meta_val, meta_why = meta_scores[i]
            score = (
                w_dense * dense_n[i]
                + w_sparse * sparse_n[i]
                + w_meta * meta_val
            )
            results.append(
                Result(
                    chunk=chunk,
                    dense=dense_n[i],
                    sparse=sparse_n[i],
                    metadata_boost=meta_val,
                    score=score,
                    why=meta_why,
                )
            )

        results.sort(key=lambda r: r.score, reverse=True)

        if rerank and rerank.lower() == "mmr":
            results = self._mmr(results, query_terms, mmr_lambda, top_k)

        results = results[:top_k]
        for rank, res in enumerate(results, start=1):
            res.rank = rank
        return results

    def _mmr(self, results: list[Result], query_terms: list[str],
             lam: float, top_k: int) -> list[Result]:
        """Maximal Marginal Relevance: relevance minus redundancy vs selected."""
        selected: list[Result] = []
        pool = list(results)
        while pool and len(selected) < top_k:
            best_i, best_val = -1, -1e18
            for i, cand in enumerate(pool):
                rel = cand.score
                if selected:
                    redundancy = max(
                        self._dense_sim(cand.chunk.tokens, s.chunk) for s in selected
                    )
                else:
                    redundancy = 0.0
                val = lam * rel - (1.0 - lam) * redundancy
                if val > best_val:
                    best_i, best_val = i, val
            selected.append(pool.pop(best_i))
        return selected

    # -- generation --------------------------------------------------------

    def generate_answer(
        self,
        query: str,
        results: list[Result],
        llm=None,
        max_snippet_chars: int = 220,
    ) -> dict:
        """
        Assemble a citation-stamped context and produce a grounded answer.

        If `llm` is a callable (prompt: str) -> str it is used as the
        generator head; otherwise an extractive, citation-backed fallback
        answer is produced from the top chunks.
        """
        context_blocks = []
        for i, res in enumerate(results, start=1):
            md = res.metadata
            context_blocks.append(
                f"[{i}] ({md['title']} | category={md['category']} | "
                f"source={md['source']} | date={md['date']} | "
                f"tags={','.join(md['tags']) or '-'})\n{res.chunk.content}"
            )
        context = "\n\n".join(context_blocks)

        prompt = (
            "Use ONLY the numbered context below to answer the question. "
            "If the context does not contain the answer, say so. "
            "Cite supporting context with [n] markers.\n\n"
            f"Context:\n{context}\n\n"
            f"Question: {query}\n\n"
            "Answer:"
        )

        if llm is not None:
            answer = str(llm(prompt)).strip()
        else:
            # Extractive fallback: pick the highest-scoring sentence across
            # the top results, keeping citation markers.
            scored_sents = []
            for res in results:
                md = res.metadata
                for sent in sentence_split(res.chunk.content):
                    q_terms = set(tokenize(query))
                    s_terms = set(tokenize(sent))
                    if not q_terms:
                        rel = 0.0
                    else:
                        rel = len(q_terms & s_terms) / len(q_terms)
                    rel *= res.score
                    scored_sents.append((rel, sent, md))
            scored_sents.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
            taken = []
            seen = set()
            for rel, sent, md in scored_sents:
                if rel <= 0.0:
                    break
                if sent in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(sent)
                taken.append(sent[:max_snippet_chars])
                if len(taken) >= 2:
                    break
            if taken:
                answer = " ".join(taken)
            else:
                answer = (
                    "I don't have enough information in the retrieved context "
                    "to answer that question."
                )

        return {
            "query": query,
            "context": context,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "answer": answer,
            "sources": [
                {
                    "rank": r.rank,
                    "chunk_id": r.chunk.chunk_id,
                    "title": r.metadata["title"],
                    "category": r.metadata["category"],
                    "source": r.metadata["source"],
                    "date": r.metadata["date"],
                    "tags": r.metadata["tags"],
                    "importance": r.metadata["importance"],
                    "scores": {
                        "dense": round(r.dense, 4),
                        "sparse": round(r.sparse, 4),
                        "metadata_boost": round(r.metadata_boost, 4),
                        "final": round(r.score, 4),
                    },
                }
                for r in results
            ],
        }


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Evaluation helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


def evaluate_relevance(query: str, results: list[Result]) -> dict:
    """Lightweight lexical-groundedness check of retrieved chunks."""
    q_terms = set(tokenize(query))
    if not q_terms:
        return {"hit_rate": 0.0, "avg_overlap": 0.0}
    overlaps = []
    for res in results:
        chunk_terms = set(res.chunk.tokens)
        overlap = len(q_terms & chunk_terms) / len(q_terms)
        overlaps.append(overlap)
    return {
        "hit_rate": sum(1 for o in overlaps if o > 0) / max(len(overlaps), 1),
        "avg_overlap": sum(overlaps) / max(len(overlaps), 1),
    }


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Demo corpus
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


def build_demo_corpus() -> list[Document]:
    d = date
    docs = [
        Document(
            doc_id="doc-tech-001",
            title="Hybrid Retrieval: Combining Keyword and Semantic Search",
            category="technical",
            source="engineering-wiki",
            author="a.kim",
            date=d(2024, 11, 2),
            tags=["retrieval", "hybrid", "bm25", "embeddings"],
            importance=0.9,
            content=(
                "Hybrid retrieval combines sparse keyword signals such as BM25 with dense "
                "semantic embeddings to get the best of both worlds. Keyword search is "
                "precise on rare identifiers and exact product names, while semantic "

                "rerank": spec.get("rerank"),

    rag = MetadataRAG(chunk_size=args.chunk_size, chunk_overlap=args.chunk_overlap)
    rag.add_documents(build_demo_corpus())

    filters = FilterSpec(
        category=args.category,
        source=args.source,
        author=args.author,
        tags=args.tags.split(",") if args.tags else None,
        min_date=args.min_date,
        max_date=args.max_date,
        min_importance=args.min_importance,
        text_contains=args.text_contains,
    )
    results = rag.retrieve(
        query=args.query,
        filters=filters,
        top_k=args.top_k,
        w_dense=args.weight_dense,
        w_sparse=args.weight_sparse,
        w_meta=args.weight_meta,
        recency_decay=args.recency_decay,
        rerank=args.rerank,
    )

    out = {
        "query": args.query,
        "filters": filters.describe(),
        "top_k": len(results),
        "evaluation": evaluate_relevance(args.query, results),
        "sources": [r.metadata for r in results],
        "scores": [
            {
                "chunk_id": r.chunk.chunk_id,
                "final": round(r.score, 4),
                "dense": round(r.dense, 4),
                "sparse": round(r.sparse, 4),
                "metadata_boost": round(r.metadata_boost, 4),
            }
            for r in results
        ],
    }
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, default=str))
    else:
        print(f"query   : {args.query}")
        print(f"filters : {filters.describe()}")
        print(f"results : {len(results)}")
        for r in results:
            md = r.metadata
            print(f"  #{r.rank} {r.chunk.chunk_id} score={r.score:+.3f} "
                  f"(dense={r.dense:.2f}, sparse={r.sparse:.2f}, meta={r.metadata_boost:+.2f}) "
                  f"| {md['title']} | {md['category']} | {md['date']} | tags={md['tags']}")


def build_arg_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Metadata-aware RAG: metadata filtering + hybrid relevance ranking."
    )
    p.add_argument("--demo", action="store_true", help="run the end-to-end demo (default)")
    p.add_argument("--query", default=None, help="retrieval query")
    p.add_argument("--category", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--source", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--author", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--tags", default=None, help="comma-separated tags (ANY match)")
    p.add_argument("--min-date", default=None, help="ISO date")
    p.add_argument("--max-date", default=None, help="ISO date")
    p.add_argument("--min-importance", type=float, default=None)
    p.add_argument("--text-contains", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--top-k", type=int, default=5)
    p.add_argument("--weight-dense", type=float, default=0.55)
    p.add_argument("--weight-sparse", type=float, default=0.30)
    p.add_argument("--weight-meta", type=float, default=0.15)
    p.add_argument("--recency-decay", type=float, default=0.02)
    p.add_argument("--rerank", choices=[None, "mmr"], default=None, nargs="?")
    p.add_argument("--chunk-size", type=int, default=70)
    p.add_argument("--chunk-overlap", type=int, default=15)
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="JSON output for CLI queries")
    return p


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_arg_parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.query:
        cli_retrieve(args)
        return 0
    run_demo()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
metadata_rag.py
===============

A self-contained, metadata-aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

Standard library only — runs anywhere, no package installs required.

Pipeline
--------
1. INDEX   : Documents are split into overlapping chunks. Each chunk is
             vectorized (TF-IDF dense-style vectors) and scored for BM25.
             Every chunk carries the full metadata of its parent document.
2. FILTER  : Retrieval applies metadata predicates (category, source,
             author, tags, date range, minimum importance) BEFORE scoring,
             so ranking only ever sees in-domain candidates.
3. RANK    : Candidates are scored with a hybrid model:
                 final = w_dense * dense_sim  +  w_sparse * bm25
                       + w_meta * metadata_boost
             where metadata_boost rewards recency, importance and
             query/tag affinity.  Scores are min-max normalized per query.
4. RERANK  : Optional Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) pass to trade
             relevance for diversity.
5. GENERATE: Top-k chunks are assembled into a numbered, citation-stamped
             context and a grounded answer is produced. An external LLM
             callable can be plugged in; otherwise an extractive,
             citation-backed fallback answer is generated.

Usage
-----
    python3 metadata_rag.py                       # run the end-to-end demo
    python3 metadata_rag.py --query "..." \
        --category technical --tags indexing \
        --min-importance 0.6 --top-k 5 --rerank mmr
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Text utilities
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]+")

STOPWORDS = frozenset(
    """
    a an and are as at be but by for from has have if in into is it its
    of on or that the their there these they this to was we were will with
    our your you not no so than then when where which while who whom
    about between can could did do does each how what why
    """.split()
)


def tokenize(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Lowercase alphanumeric tokens, stopwords removed."""
    return [t for t in TOKEN_RE.findall(text.lower()) if t not in STOPWORDS]


def _parse_date(value) -> date:
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value
    return datetime.fromisoformat(str(value)).date()


def sentence_split(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [s.strip() for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text) if s.strip()]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data model
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class Document:
    """A source document plus its metadata."""

    doc_id: str
    title: str
    content: str
    category: str = "general"            # technical | research | policy | ...
    source: str = "internal"
    author: str = "unknown"
    date: date | str | None = None       # publish / effective date
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    importance: float = 0.5              # 0.0 (low) .. 1.0 (high)
    extra: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    def metadata_dict(self, chunk_index: int | None = None) -> dict:
        md = {
            "doc_id": self.doc_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "category": self.category,
            "source": self.source,
            "author": self.author,
            "date": self.date.isoformat() if isinstance(self.date, date) else self.date,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "importance": self.importance,
        }
        md.update(self.extra)
        if chunk_index is not None:
            md["chunk_index"] = chunk_index
        return md


@dataclass
class Chunk:
    chunk_id: str
    doc: Document
    chunk_index: int
    content: str
    tokens: list[str]
    tf: Counter                      # raw term frequencies
    tfidf: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)  # term -> tf-idf weight


@dataclass
class Result:
    """A scored, ranked retrieval hit."""

    chunk: Chunk
    dense: float = 0.0
    sparse: float = 0.0
    metadata_boost: float = 0.0
    score: float = 0.0
    rank: int = 0
    why: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # human-readable ranking notes

    @property
    def metadata(self) -> dict:
        return self.chunk.doc.metadata_dict(self.chunk.chunk_index)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata filter
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class FilterSpec:
    """Declarative metadata predicates applied before ranking."""

    category: str | None = None
    source: str | None = None
    author: str | None = None
    tags: list[str] | None = None          # ANY-of semantics (see tags_all)
    tags_all: bool = False                  # True -> require ALL listed tags
    min_date: date | str | None = None
    max_date: date | str | None = None
    min_importance: float | None = None
    text_contains: str | None = None        # literal substring filter on chunk text

    def matches(self, chunk: Chunk) -> tuple[bool, list[str]]:
        """Return (ok, reasons). reasons explains rejections for diagnostics."""
        doc = chunk.doc
        if self.category and doc.category != self.category:
            return False, [f"category != {self.category!r}"]
        if self.source and doc.source != self.source:
            return False, [f"source != {self.source!r}"]
        if self.author and doc.author != self.author:
            return False, [f"author != {self.author!r}"]
        if self.tags:
            doc_tags = set(doc.tags)
            want = set(self.tags)
            if self.tags_all:
                if not want.issubset(doc_tags):
                    return False, [f"missing tags {sorted(want - doc_tags)}"]
            elif not want.intersection(doc_tags):
                return False, [f"no tag overlap with {sorted(want)}"]
        doc_date = doc.date if isinstance(doc.date, date) else None
        if self.min_date:
            lo = _parse_date(self.min_date)
            if doc_date is None or doc_date < lo:
                return False, [f"date < {lo.isoformat()}"]
        if self.max_date:
            hi = _parse_date(self.max_date)
            if doc_date is None or doc_date > hi:
                return False, [f"date > {hi.isoformat()}"]
        if self.min_importance is not None and doc.importance < self.min_importance:
            return False, [f"importance < {self.min_importance}"]
        if self.text_contains and self.text_contains.lower() not in chunk.content.lower():
            return False, [f"chunk lacks substring {self.text_contains!r}"]
        return True, []

    def describe(self) -> str:
        parts = []
        for name in ("category", "source", "author", "min_date", "max_date",
                     "min_importance", "text_contains"):
            val = getattr(self, name)
            if val is not None:
                parts.append(f"{name}={val!r}")
        if self.tags:
            parts.append(f"tags={self.tags} (all={self.tags_all})")
        return " & ".join(parts) if parts else "(no metadata filters)"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The RAG system
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


class MetadataRAG:
    """
    Index documents, then retrieve chunks using metadata filtering +
    hybrid dense/sparse relevance ranking with metadata boosts.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        chunk_size: int = 140,
        chunk_overlap: int = 25,
        bm25_k1: float = 1.5,
        bm25_b: float = 0.75,
        reference_date: date | None = None,
    ):
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.chunk_overlap = chunk_overlap
        self.bm25_k1 = bm25_k1
        self.bm25_b = bm25_b
        self.reference_date = reference_date  # resolved at index time

        self.documents: list[Document] = []
        self.chunks: list[Chunk] = []
        self._df: Counter = Counter()      # document frequency per term
        self._idf: dict[str, float] = {}
        self._avgdl: float = 0.0
        self._max_date: date | None = None

    # -- indexing ----------------------------------------------------------

    def add_documents(self, docs: list[Document]) -> int:
        """Chunk and index new documents (incremental API)."""
        new_chunks: list[Chunk] = []
        for doc in docs:
            for i, piece in enumerate(self._split(doc.content)):
                tokens = tokenize(piece)
                chunk_id = f"{doc.doc_id}#c{i}"
                new_chunks.append(
                    Chunk(
                        chunk_id=chunk_id,
                        doc=doc,
                        chunk_index=i,
                        content=piece,
                        tokens=tokens,
                        tf=Counter(tokens),
                    )
                )
        self.documents.extend(docs)
        self.chunks.extend(new_chunks)
        self._recompute_stats()
        for chunk in self.chunks:
            chunk.tfidf = {
                term: tf * self._idf.get(term, 0.0)
                for term, tf in chunk.tf.items()
            }
        return len(new_chunks)

    def _split(self, text: str) -> list[str]:
        """Sentence-aware overlapping chunking."""
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) <= self.chunk_size:
            return [text]
        chunks: list[str] = []
        start = 0
        while start < len(words):
            end = min(start + self.chunk_size, len(words))
            chunk_text = " ".join(words[start:end])
            # don't cut mid-sentence at a boundary if a sentence break is near
            candidate = " ".join(words[min(start + self.chunk_overlap, len(words) - 1):end])
            if start > 0 and "." in candidate and end < len(words):
                pass  # keep simple overlap; sentence boundary preserved at start
            chunks.append(chunk_text)
            if end == len(words):
                break
            start = max(start + self.chunk_size - self.chunk_overlap, start + 1)
        return chunks

    def _recompute_stats(self) -> None:
        """(Re)compute IDF, average length and reference date over the corpus."""
        n = len(self.chunks)
        self._df = Counter()
        total_len = 0
        for chunk in self.chunks:
            total_len += len(chunk.tokens)
            for term in set(chunk.tokens):
                self._df[term] += 1
        self._avgdl = total_len / n if n else 0.0
        self._idf = {
            term: math.log((n - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5) + 1.0)
            for term, df in self._df.items()
        }
        dates = [
            d.date
            for d in self.documents
            if isinstance(d.date, date)
        ]
        self._max_date = max(dates) if dates else None
        if self.reference_date is None:
            self.reference_date = self._max_date or date.today()

    # -- scoring -----------------------------------------------------------

    def _dense_sim(self, query_terms: list[str], chunk: Chunk) -> float:
        """Cosine similarity between the query TF-IDF vector and chunk TF-IDF."""
        q_counter = Counter(query_terms)
        q_vec = {t: c * self._idf.get(t, 0.0) for t, c in q_counter.items()}
        dot = 0.0
        q_norm = 0.0
        c_norm = 0.0
        for t, qw in q_vec.items():
            q_norm += qw * qw
            cw = chunk.tfidf.get(t)
            if cw:
                dot += qw * cw
        for cw in chunk.tfidf.values():
            c_norm += cw * cw
        if q_norm == 0.0 or c_norm == 0.0:
            return 0.0
        return dot / (math.sqrt(q_norm) * math.sqrt(c_norm))

    def _bm25(self, query_terms: list[str], chunk: Chunk) -> float:
        """BM25 score of one chunk against the query terms."""
        k1, b = self.bm25_k1, self.bm25_b
        dl = len(chunk.tokens)
        denom = k1 * (1.0 - b + b * (dl / self._avgdl)) if self._avgdl else 1.0
        score = 0.0
        for term in set(query_terms):
            df = self._df.get(term, 0)
            if df == 0:
                continue
            idf = math.log((len(self.chunks) - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5) + 1.0)
            tf = chunk.tf.get(term, 0)
            if tf == 0:
                continue
            score += idf * (tf * (k1 + 1.0)) / (tf + denom)
        return score

    def _metadata_boost(self, query_terms: list[str], chunk: Chunk,
                        recency_decay: float) -> tuple[float, list[str]]:
        """
        Metadata-based relevance boosts, returned as (boost_value, reasons):
          * recency:   exp(-decay * age_in_days)          -> fresher wins
          * importance: (importance - 0.5) * 2            -> -1..+1
          * tag match:  +0.5 per query term found in doc tags
        """
        boost = 0.0
        why: list[str] = []
        doc = chunk.doc

        if isinstance(doc.date, date) and self.reference_date:
            age_days = max((self.reference_date - doc.date).days, 0)
            rec = math.exp(-recency_decay * age_days)
            boost += rec - 0.5  # recent docs >0, old docs <0
            why.append(f"recency={rec:.2f} (age={age_days}d)")

        imp = (doc.importance - 0.5) * 2.0
        boost += 0.5 * imp
        why.append(f"importance={doc.importance:.2f}")

        tag_hits = 0
        for term in query_terms:
            if term in doc.tags:
                tag_hits += 1
        if tag_hits:
            boost += 0.5 * min(tag_hits, 3)
            why.append(f"tag_hits={tag_hits}")
        return boost, why

    # -- retrieval ---------------------------------------------------------

    def retrieve(
        self,
        query: str,
        filters: FilterSpec | None = None,
        top_k: int = 5,
        w_dense: float = 0.55,
        w_sparse: float = 0.30,
        w_meta: float = 0.15,
        recency_decay: float = 0.02,
        rerank: str | None = None,          # None | "mmr"
        mmr_lambda: float = 0.6,
        verbose_why: bool = True,
    ) -> list[Result]:
        """
        Filter by metadata, rank by hybrid relevance, optionally diversify.

        Returns top-k Result objects, each with per-signal score breakdown.
        """
        query_terms = tokenize(query)
        filters = filters or FilterSpec()

        candidates: list[tuple[Chunk, list[str]]] = []
        rejected = Counter()
        for chunk in self.chunks:
            ok, reasons = filters.matches(chunk)
            if ok:
                candidates.append((chunk, []))
            else:
                rejected[reasons[0]] += 1

        if not candidates:
            return []

        # per-signal scoring
        dense_scores: list[float] = []
        sparse_scores: list[float] = []
        meta_scores: list[tuple[float, list[str]]] = []
        for chunk, _ in candidates:
            dense_scores.append(self._dense_sim(query_terms, chunk))
            sparse_scores.append(self._bm25(query_terms, chunk))
            meta_scores.append(self._metadata_boost(query_terms, chunk, recency_decay))

        def norm(scores: list[float]) -> list[float]:
            mx = max(scores) if scores else 0.0
            if mx <= 1e-12:
                return [0.0] * len(scores)
            return [s / mx for s in scores]

        dense_n, sparse_n = norm(dense_scores), norm(sparse_scores)
        if not query_terms:
            dense_n = [0.0] * len(candidates)  # no lexical signal -> rely on meta

        results: list[Result] = []
        for i, (chunk, _) in enumerate(candidates):
            meta_val, meta_why = meta_scores[i]
            score = (
                w_dense * dense_n[i]
                + w_sparse * sparse_n[i]
                + w_meta * meta_val
            )
            results.append(
                Result(
                    chunk=chunk,
                    dense=dense_n[i],
                    sparse=sparse_n[i],
                    metadata_boost=meta_val,
                    score=score,
                    why=meta_why,
                )
            )

        results.sort(key=lambda r: r.score, reverse=True)

        if rerank and rerank.lower() == "mmr":
            results = self._mmr(results, query_terms, mmr_lambda, top_k)

        results = results[:top_k]
        for rank, res in enumerate(results, start=1):
            res.rank = rank
        return results

    def _mmr(self, results: list[Result], query_terms: list[str],
             lam: float, top_k: int) -> list[Result]:
        """Maximal Marginal Relevance: relevance minus redundancy vs selected."""
        selected: list[Result] = []
        pool = list(results)
        while pool and len(selected) < top_k:
            best_i, best_val = -1, -1e18
            for i, cand in enumerate(pool):
                rel = cand.score
                if selected:
                    redundancy = max(
                        self._dense_sim(cand.chunk.tokens, s.chunk) for s in selected
                    )
                else:
                    redundancy = 0.0
                val = lam * rel - (1.0 - lam) * redundancy
                if val > best_val:
                    best_i, best_val = i, val
            selected.append(pool.pop(best_i))
        return selected

    # -- generation --------------------------------------------------------

    def generate_answer(
        self,
        query: str,
        results: list[Result],
        llm=None,
        max_snippet_chars: int = 220,
    ) -> dict:
        """
        Assemble a citation-stamped context and produce a grounded answer.

        If `llm` is a callable (prompt: str) -> str it is used as the
        generator head; otherwise an extractive, citation-backed fallback
        answer is produced from the top chunks.
        """
        context_blocks = []
        for i, res in enumerate(results, start=1):
            md = res.metadata
            context_blocks.append(
                f"[{i}] ({md['title']} | category={md['category']} | "
                f"source={md['source']} | date={md['date']} | "
                f"tags={','.join(md['tags']) or '-'})\n{res.chunk.content}"
            )
        context = "\n\n".join(context_blocks)

        prompt = (
            "Use ONLY the numbered context below to answer the question. "
            "If the context does not contain the answer, say so. "
            "Cite supporting context with [n] markers.\n\n"
            f"Context:\n{context}\n\n"
            f"Question: {query}\n\n"
            "Answer:"
        )

        if llm is not None:
            answer = str(llm(prompt)).strip()
        else:
            # Extractive fallback: pick the highest-scoring sentence across
            # the top results, keeping citation markers.
            scored_sents = []
            for res in results:
                md = res.metadata
                for sent in sentence_split(res.chunk.content):
                    q_terms = set(tokenize(query))
                    s_terms = set(tokenize(sent))
                    if not q_terms:
                        rel = 0.0
                    else:
                        rel = len(q_terms & s_terms) / len(q_terms)
                    rel *= res.score
                    scored_sents.append((rel, sent, md))
            scored_sents.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
            taken = []
            seen = set()
            for rel, sent, md in scored_sents:
                if rel <= 0.0:
                    break
                if sent in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(sent)
                taken.append(sent[:max_snippet_chars])
                if len(taken) >= 2:
                    break
            if taken:
                answer = " ".join(taken)
            else:
                answer = (
                    "I don't have enough information in the retrieved context "
                    "to answer that question."
                )

        return {
            "query": query,
            "context": context,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "answer": answer,
            "sources": [
                {
                    "rank": r.rank,
                    "chunk_id": r.chunk.chunk_id,
                    "title": r.metadata["title"],
                    "category": r.metadata["category"],
                    "source": r.metadata["source"],
                    "date": r.metadata["date"],
                    "tags": r.metadata["tags"],
                    "importance": r.metadata["importance"],
                    "scores": {
                        "dense": round(r.dense, 4),
                        "sparse": round(r.sparse, 4),
                        "metadata_boost": round(r.metadata_boost, 4),
                        "final": round(r.score, 4),
                    },
                }
                for r in results
            ],
        }

def evaluate_relevance(query: str, results: list[Result]) -> dict:
    """Lightweight lexical-groundedness check of retrieved chunks."""
    q_terms = set(tokenize(query))
    if not q_terms:
        return {"hit_rate": 0.0, "avg_overlap": 0.0}
    overlaps = []
    for res in results:
        chunk_terms = set(res.chunk.tokens)
        overlap = len(q_terms & chunk_terms) / len(q_terms)
        overlaps.append(overlap)
    return {
        "hit_rate": sum(1 for o in overlaps if o > 0) / max(len(overlaps), 1),
        "avg_overlap": sum(overlaps) / max(len(overlaps), 1),
    }

        results = rag.retrieve(
            query=spec["query"],
            filters=filters,
            top_k=spec.get("top_k", 4),
            rerank=spec.get("rerank"),
        )
        if not results:
            print("  -> No chunks passed the metadata filters.\n")
            summary["queries"].append({"name": spec["name"], "results": []})
            continue

        eval_metrics = evaluate_relevance(spec["query"], results)
        print(f"  top-{len(results)} results (hit_rate={eval_metrics['hit_rate']:.2f}, "
              f"avg_overlap={eval_metrics['avg_overlap']:.2f}):")
        for r in results:
            md = r.metadata
            print(f"    #{r.rank} {r.chunk.chunk_id}  score={r.score:+.3f}  "
                  f"[dense={r.dense:.2f}, sparse={r.sparse:.2f}, meta={r.metadata_boost:+.2f}]")
            print(f"        {md['title']} | {md['category']} | {md['source']} | "
                  f"{md['date']} | importance={md['importance']} | tags={md['tags']}")
            if r.why:
                print(f"        why: {', '.join(r.why)}")
            snippet = r.chunk.content[:160].replace("\n", " ")
            print(f"        ...{snippet}...")

        answer = rag.generate_answer(spec["query"], results)
        print(f"\n  GROUNDED ANSWER ({len(results)} citations available):")
        print(f"    {answer['answer'][:300]}")
        print(f"    sources: {[s['chunk_id'] for s in answer['sources']]}")
        print()

        summary["queries"].append(
            {
                "name": spec["name"],
                "query": spec["query"],
                "filters": filters.describe() if filters else None,
                "rerank": spec.get("rerank"),
                "top_k": len(results),
                "evaluation": eval_metrics,
                "sources": answer["sources"],
                "answer": answer["answer"],
            }
        )

    print("=" * 78)
    return summary


def cli_retrieve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    rag = MetadataRAG(chunk_size=args.chunk_size, chunk_overlap=args.chunk_overlap)
    rag.add_documents(build_demo_corpus())

    filters = FilterSpec(
        category=args.category,
        source=args.source,
        author=args.author,
        tags=args.tags.split(",") if args.tags else None,
        min_date=args.min_date,
        max_date=args.max_date,
        min_importance=args.min_importance,
        text_contains=args.text_contains,
    )
    results = rag.retrieve(
        query=args.query,
        filters=filters,
        top_k=args.top_k,
        w_dense=args.weight_dense,
        w_sparse=args.weight_sparse,
        w_meta=args.weight_meta,
        recency_decay=args.recency_decay,
        rerank=args.rerank,
    )

    out = {
        "query": args.query,
        "filters": filters.describe(),
        "top_k": len(results),
        "evaluation": evaluate_relevance(args.query, results),
        "sources": [r.metadata for r in results],
        "scores": [
            {
                "chunk_id": r.chunk.chunk_id,
                "final": round(r.score, 4),
                "dense": round(r.dense, 4),
                "sparse": round(r.sparse, 4),
                "metadata_boost": round(r.metadata_boost, 4),
            }
            for r in results
        ],
    }
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, default=str))
    else:
        print(f"query   : {args.query}")
        print(f"filters : {filters.describe()}")
        print(f"results : {len(results)}")
        for r in results:
            md = r.metadata
            print(f"  #{r.rank} {r.chunk.chunk_id} score={r.score:+.3f} "
                  f"(dense={r.dense:.2f}, sparse={r.sparse:.2f}, meta={r.metadata_boost:+.2f}) "
                  f"| {md['title']} | {md['category']} | {md['date']} | tags={md['tags']}")


def build_arg_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Metadata-aware RAG: metadata filtering + hybrid relevance ranking."
    )
    p.add_argument("--demo", action="store_true", help="run the end-to-end demo (default)")
    p.add_argument("--query", default=None, help="retrieval query")
    p.add_argument("--category", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--source", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--author", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--tags", default=None, help="comma-separated tags (ANY match)")
    p.add_argument("--min-date", default=None, help="ISO date")
    p.add_argument("--max-date", default=None, help="ISO date")
    p.add_argument("--min-importance", type=float, default=None)
    p.add_argument("--text-contains", default=None)
    p.add_argument("--top-k", type=int, default=5)
    p.add_argument("--weight-dense", type=float, default=0.55)
    p.add_argument("--weight-sparse", type=float, default=0.30)
    p.add_argument("--weight-meta", type=float, default=0.15)
    p.add_argument("--recency-decay", type=float, default=0.02)
    p.add_argument("--rerank", choices=[None, "mmr"], default=None, nargs="?")
    p.add_argument("--chunk-size", type=int, default=70)
    p.add_argument("--chunk-overlap", type=int, default=15)
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="JSON output for CLI queries")
    return p


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_arg_parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.query:
        cli_retrieve(args)
        return 0
    run_demo()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
